# Unicorn Overlord: title -> New Game -> prologue -> first battle, then play the battle.
# Frames are 60 Hz ticks of game time since the first present.
#
# The prologue advances on one A press every 300 frames (5 s). The battle tutorial starts around
# frame 18000 (300 s); from there presses come faster and the d-pad walks the cursor, which is
# what the tutorial asks for (select the unit, then move it onto the enemy).
